name: What is the process for professional bathtub drain cleaning?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for professional bathtub drain cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for professional bathtub drain cleaning typically begins with an inspection to identify the cause and location of the clog. For common clogs like hair and soap scum, a plumber might use a drain snake to physically break up and remove the obstruction. For more severe blockages or recurring issues, hydro-jetting, which uses high-pressure water, may be employed to thoroughly clean the pipe walls. The technician will then test the drain flow to ensure the issue is fully resolved.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional bathtub drain cleaning involves inspection, using a drain snake or hydro-jetting to clear the clog, and then testing the flow.
